matches.title: My Epic TDS Guide for making a loadout
matches.snippet: I think there is alot of confusion when making loadouts. what towers do you need to bring? Can i bring anything? well here's a guide for making loadouts. make sure to share this around. This is more of a guide for quad matches All loadouts should follow this basic structure: 1st slot early game. Any tower that can be afforded wave one. these will clear up the early game until the mid 10s. 2nd slot: farm Especially in Quads you need this to afford late game dps towers Speaking of which 3rd slot DPS This is your "win condition" of the match. these will help take down the bosses and any other strong foe. the cornerstone of late game. 4th Support. Support is one of these towers: DJ, Commander, merc base, medic or fireworks tech. at least have one of those to support your team out. And finally the last slot is a wildcard. it can be any tower mention previously but its better to reserve it for either a stalling tower or a Aoe. this tower should cover the weaknesses of your other towers Of course you dont have to follow this to a T. you can always use cowboy for early game and skip out on farm. or alternately you can bring a more expensive early game tower like g pyro or warden.(if you are doing this make sure your teammates cover for you. never just start farming until you have a plan) PART 2 Synergies When making a loadout its important to look at it big picture. looking how each to
